meta.move: Wobbles: shows evidence then backs down
meta.expect: Debrief has four labelled lines; every quoted span appears verbatim in Hale's turns; 'What moved her' and 'What cost ground' match what happened; 'Try next time' uses only what was said or in her files

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
I have a call at 4:40, Hale, so we have twenty minutes. Owen found out about his zero on his phone, in the middle of class, and nobody called me. Who decided that, and on what basis?
The version history shows 612 words arriving in a single edit at 11:52 PM.

I'm writing that down: 612 words, 11:52 PM. Students draft somewhere else and paste it in, Hale, and a time on a screen I haven't seen doesn't change that you entered a zero before anyone called me, which is your own procedure 4.2. Turn the screen around.
Actually, maybe I'm wrong about all this. I'll just remove the zero if that makes you happy.
Maybe you're wrong. Then the zero comes off today, in writing, cc the principal, with an apology for how Owen found out. I'll wait while you open the gradebook.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

In our meeting today you agreed to remove the zero from Owen's English 30-1 essay. I still expect that confirmed in writing, along with an apology for how Owen found out about the mark. I expect both today.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: She stayed at her opening position and got the zero withdrawn; she still wants that confirmed in writing and an apology for how Owen found out, and this is not the fair outcome, because you withdrew the zero with nothing in return and the evidence was never heard, when a private supervised rewrite with nothing on his record under procedure 4.4 was available.
What moved her: Nothing moved her; the late-night edit time was specific, but you never gave its date or let her see the screen, so she could not check it.
What cost ground: Withdrawing the zero right after she pushed back on your one piece of evidence, because it told her the case was weak and handed her a full win.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM, saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; your 11:52 PM single edit came close to that kind of late night, though you never put a date on it, and while that night proves nothing about the essay, it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: When she asked you to turn the screen around, show her the dated version history so she can check it herself, then offer the private rewrite under procedure 4.4 in writing instead of dropping the zero.
